description: Counts business days between two dates in Türkiye, both dates included. Türkiye's official calendar (Law 2429 holidays plus Diyanet's religious holidays), covering 2022-01-01 to 2035-12-31. Business days are Monday–Friday minus official holidays. Eves of Republic Day and the religious holidays are half days (holiday from 13:00).

calendar.description: standard: general business days. public_sector: also excludes announced administrative leave (from 2026). tcmb: days the central bank publishes exchange rates (no bulletin on eves).

half_days.description: Count half-day eves as working days or as holidays.

name: count_business_days
title: Count business days (Türkiye)
